name: Ichibei Hyosube

power.name: Ichimonji
power.notes: Commands the concept of 'black' across the cosmos; rewrites names and divine properties through white ink.

powerSteps.title: Shikai
powerSteps.name: Ichimonji
powerSteps.desc: A giant calligraphy brush that paints black ink over opponents, stripping their names, concepts, and physical powers.

powerSteps.title: Shin'uchi (Original Bankai)
powerSteps.name: Shirafude Ichimonji
powerSteps.desc: Writes new names in white ink onto blackened targets, granting them the fragility of whatever is written—such as a black ant.

powerSteps.title: Secret Art
powerSteps.name: Futen Taisatsuryo
powerSteps.desc: Steals one hundred nights from the future of Soul Society to completely extinguish existence down to the reincarnating soul.

blurb: The ancient leader of the Zero Division who named everything in the Soul Society—including Zanpakuto, Shikai, and Bankai. His calligraphy ink governs the primordial concept of black to strip divine names from foes.
storyboard: Anticipation: blinds silhouette emerges with a brief elastic cue.
Cover: Signature Ichibei Hyosube color field (#baeff3) expands across screen.
Reveal: Cover dissolves as Ichimonji sweeps into focus.

name: Tenjiro Kirinji
aliases: First Officer of the Royal Guard

power.name: Kinpika
power.notes: Inventor of healing hot springs; manipulates scalding medicinal waters and boiling red blood springs.

powerSteps.title: Spring Arts
powerSteps.name: White Bone & Blood Pond Springs
powerSteps.desc: Floods the battlefield with scalding mineral springs that flush out contaminated blood or boil enemy flesh on contact.

powerSteps.title: Shikai
powerSteps.name: Kinpika
powerSteps.desc: A glowing halberd bathed in blinding sunlight that strikes with lightning-swift polearm speed.

blurb: The brash hot spring physician who taught Unohana the foundational healing arts of the Soul Society. His scalding healing waters flush tainted blood while his halberd moves with blinding speed.
storyboard: Anticipation: chain-links silhouette emerges with a brief drift cue.
Cover: Signature Tenjiro Kirinji color field (#becff4) expands across screen.
Reveal: Cover dissolves as Kinpika sweeps into focus.

name: Senjumaru Shutara

power.name: Shigarami & Divine Loom
power.notes: Inventor of the Shihakusho garments; controls millions of needle-threads to weave tapestries of fatal destiny.

powerSteps.title: Weaving Art
powerSteps.name: Thousand Arm Loom
powerSteps.desc: Deploys mechanical golden needle-arms to rewrite fabrics, stitch lethal traps, and slip past impenetrable barriers.

powerSteps.title: Bankai
powerSteps.name: Shatatsu Karagara Shigarami no Tsuji
powerSteps.desc: Unrolls a massive loom that weaves custom fabric tapestries matching each opponent's nature, freezing, burning, and crushing them in destined cloth prisons.

blurb: The elegant weaver of the Royal Guard who designed the protective Shihakusho garments worn by all Soul Reapers. Her monumental loom weaves fabric tapestries that execute custom fates for invading armies.
storyboard: Anticipation: bars silhouette emerges with a brief elastic cue.
Cover: Signature Senjumaru Shutara color field (#d1c2f5) expands across screen.
Reveal: Cover dissolves as Shigarami & Divine Loom sweeps into focus.

name: Oetsu Nimaiya

power.name: Sayafushi
power.notes: Creator of all Asauchi; wields Sayafushi, a blade so sharp and frictionless no scabbard can hold it.

powerSteps.title: Failed Masterpiece
powerSteps.name: Sayafushi
powerSteps.desc: An edge so impossibly sharp that blood slides off without wetting the steel, cleaving elite Quincy weapons with single taps.

blurb: The energetic, rhyming master smith who forged the very first Asauchi and created every Zanpakuto in history. In combat, he wields a scabbard-less sword so sharp that blood cannot cling to its edge.
storyboard: Anticipation: waves silhouette emerges with a brief drift cue.
Cover: Signature Oetsu Nimaiya color field (#f2c6f6) expands across screen.
Reveal: Cover dissolves as Sayafushi sweeps into focus.

name: Kirio Hikifune

power.name: Cage of Life & Artificial Souls
power.notes: Inventor of the Gikongan (artificial soul); cultivates living spiritual food and wood that feeds on reiatsu.

powerSteps.title: Creation
powerSteps.name: Cage of Life
powerSteps.desc: Summons a dense forest cage of living spiritual trees that actively absorb and drink incoming reishi attacks to grow thicker.

blurb: The warm culinary master who invented the artificial soul technology fundamental to modern Soul Reaper operations. Her dense Cage of Life feeds upon enemy spiritual energy to block holy arrows.
storyboard: Anticipation: torn-paper silhouette emerges with a brief elastic cue.
Cover: Signature Kirio Hikifune color field (#f7cadf) expands across screen.
Reveal: Cover dissolves as Cage of Life & Artificial Souls sweeps into focus.
